# VMLS/1 codecs

> Rust wire codecs shared by VMLS/1 callers. Covers the application envelope, device bindings and capabilities around an MLS engine.

## Documentation

- [Codec scope](https://github.com/forgesworn/vmls-core/blob/main/README.md): Supported builds and conformance coverage.
- [Wire contract](https://github.com/forgesworn/vmls-core/blob/main/VMLS-1.md): Canonical records, verification and caller responsibilities.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/vmls-core): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
